Our task is to find A, B and C such that

−2x2+29x+1(4x−1)(x+3)(x+1)=A(4x−1)+B(x+3)+C(x+1).

Multiplying both sides by (4x−1)(x+3)(x+1) gives

−2x2+29x+1=A(x+3)(x+1)+B(4x−1)(x+1)+C(4x−1)(x+3).

For x=14, we get −2(14)2+29(14)+1=A(14+3)(14+1)=+B(4(14)−1)(14+1)=+C(4(14)−1)(14+3)−18+294+1=A(6516)658=A(6516)A=168A=2.

For x=−3, we get −2(−3)2+29(−3)+1=A(−3+3)(−3+1)=+B(4(−3)−1)(−3+1)=+C(4(−3)−1)(−3+3)−18−87+1=B(−13)(−2)B=−10426B=−4.

For x=−1, we get −2(−1)2+29(−1)+1=A(−1+3)(−1+1)=+B(4(−1)−1)(−1+1)=+C(4(−1)−1)(−1+3)−2−29+1=C(−5)(2)C=−30−10C=3. Hence, −2x2+29x+1(4x−1)(x+3)(x+1)=2(4x−1)−4(x+3)+3(x+1).

Your Answer:
1(4x−1)−6(x+3)+3(x+1)
